title: 50.5% of Americans Say AI Romance Can Count as Cheating
summary: A survey of 2,150 U.S. adults reveals that 50.5% consider romantic or sexual relationships with AI as a form of cheating, highlighting growing societal concerns about AI companions and their impact on human relationships.
problem_solved: Quantifies public attitudes toward AI romantic relationships and their ethical implications.
why_valuable: Provides empirical data on how society perceives AI-human romantic interactions, which is valuable for developers and policymakers navigating AI ethics.
